## Why it happens

The gateway was installed without the server address and access token, so it does not know where to connect.

## Fix it

Add the host and token in `st_gateway.json` or on the gateway's local web page. The gateway commissions itself within seconds; no restart is needed. Values set through environment variables need a restart.

## Check that it worked

The gateway appears active on the **Gateways** page.
